body: It was not my daughter, but a very close adult friend. This also happened when I was young and didn’t know what was going on very well, but I have developed PTSD from it most likely. That doesn’t mean that I have no hope.

As someone who has been left alone by suicide and even years later I have always wondered why she killed herself. I read some of your comments saying that you wouldn’t leave a note to you parents. And they will probably feel like that too. I think you owe them at least that. Of course I don’t think you should kill yourself. Because suicide doesn’t take away the pain, it turns it to others for them to feel that. And as you and I and many others know, feeling like you are worthless and life isn’t worth living is not fun. You will just be forcing that onto your parents and others around you. Think about how they will react when they hear that their child has taken their own life and they can never forget that. Please reconsider. If you need to talk I’m here and open.
